name: Expense Claims
nameTh: เบิกค่าใช้จ่าย
description: Employee expense claims and cash advances: categories with per-person monthly limits (warn, never block) and receipt rules, numbered claims (EXP-2569-0001) with VAT lines, submit / approve / reject / return / pay (transfer, cash, cheque), cash advances (ADV-…) cleared against claims with the amount to return or pay more, printable claim form with baht text, spend by category, monthly trend and an outstanding-to-pay report.
